page_title: LOR 1-7 LIL | Lorient v Lille 30/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Romain Lissorgue to decide. The relieved Lille players can finally celebrate.
90+6' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Lille players aren’t happy.

90+5' 1 - 7 Goal! Osame Sahraoui (Lille) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Bingourou Kamara had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:7.
90+3' 1 - 6 Goal! Hamza Igamane (Lille) scores after an assist by Benjamin Andre that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:6.
90+2' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
90+1' Great teamplay by Lille as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
90+1' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) is adjudged offside.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Hamza Igamane (Lille) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
88' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ayyoub Bouaddi walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ugo Raghouber (Lille).

87' 1 - 5 Goal! Romain Perraud plays in Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 1:5.
86' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
86' Osame Sahraoui (Lille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Corner kick. Lille will have an opportunity.
85' Substitution. Aissa Mandi (Lille) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Thomas Meunier walks off.
85' We are about to witness a subsitution. Osame Sahraoui (Lille) for Mathias Fernandez-Pardo.
82' Substitution. Felix Correia did his best and is replaced by Nabil Bentaleb (Lille).
82' Olivier Pantaloni decides to make a substitution. Arsene Kouassi will be replaced by Darlin Yongwa (Lorient).
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Theo Le Bris (Lorient) will replace Arthur Avom.
80' 1 - 4 Hamza Igamane (Lille) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
80' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) controls the ball on the edge of the box, runs inside and thunders a shot against the crossbar.
77' 1 - 3 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 1:3.
76' Igor Silva (Lorient) commits a rough foul. Romain Lissorgue stops the game and makes a call.
75' Felix Correia (Lille) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
73' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
72' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lorient comes to nothing.
72' Dermane Karim (Lorient) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Lorient force their opponents to concede a corner.
71' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
69' Romain Perraud (Lille) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
68' Here is a change. Sambou Soumano is going off and Olivier Pantaloni gives the last tactical orders to Mohamed Bamba (Lorient).
68' Substitution. Aiyegun Tosin makes way for Noah Cadiou (Lorient).
68' Romain Perraud (Lille) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
67' Lille are seeing far more of the ball now.
64' 1 - 2 Goal - 1:2! Sambou Soumano laid the ball off to Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
64' Sambou Soumano (Lorient) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the bottom left corner, but Berke Ozer leaps out to thwart his attempt.
64' Sambou Soumano (Lorient) is going to take the penalty!
63' Dangerous play by Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille). Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul. The referee blows his whistle and awards Lorient a penalty after chaos inside the box.
59' It must be a yellow card. It is. Benjamin Andre (Lille) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
58' Romain Lissorgue blows the whistle, Abdoulaye Faye (Lorient) is penalised for a foul. Lille win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
56' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lorient, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.

53' 0 - 2 Felix Correia produces a sweet pass and picks out Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 0:2!
52' The Lorient players are stunned as referee Romain Lissorgue changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
52' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Lorient using VAR. Let's see what happens.
51' Romain Perraud (Lille) handles the ball inside the penalty area. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. Lorient are awarded a penalty.
51' Igor Silva (Lorient) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
48' A player from Lorient brings down an opponent and commits a foul. It's a free kick to Lille in a dangerous position.
46' 0 - 1 Goal! Hamza Igamane plays a simple square pass into the feet of Romain Perraud (Lille) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
46' Marius Broholm goes off the pitch and Hamza Igamane (Lille) comes on.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+3' Benjamin Andre (Lille) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top left corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
45+2' There's an opportunity for Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
45+1' Marius Broholm (Lille) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Romain Lissorgue who sees an offensive foul. Lorient are awarded a free kick.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
40' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Romain Lissorgue had an easy-decision to make.
39' Lille are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
37' Abdoulaye Faye (Lorient) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
35' Corner kick. Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) is ready to send the ball into the box.
34' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
33' The corner is swung in but Lorient can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
33' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Now Lorient have a corner.
32' Handball! A player from Lille handled the ball.
31' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Dermane Karim (Lorient). Romain Lissorgue saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
28' Arthur Avom (Lorient) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
26' Lille will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
25' Thomas Meunier (Lille) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is behind the touchline and Lorient will take a throw-in.
24' Thomas Meunier (Lille) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
22' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
20' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
16' A corner kick by Lorient is thwarted by the well prepared Berke Ozer (Lille).
15' The game has come to an end for Panos Katseris. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient).
14' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 1:1. The shots on goal statistics – 0:0.
12' Panos Katseris (Lorient) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
11' Panos Katseris (Lorient) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Romain Lissorgue no option but to blow his whistle.
10' Lille players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.

7' Alexsandro (Lille) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
7' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
7' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Lille get a corner.
6' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lorient, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
5' Benjamin Andre (Lille) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Romain Lissorgue saw the whole situation. Lorient earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
4' Marius Broholm (Lille) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
3' Lorient move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Lille will kick-off.
Romain Lissorgue is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
